question: Does a causal volatility-normalized 15-minute relative displacement among US30, US100 and US500 produce a sufficiently frequent and double-spread-positive 30-minute reversion or continuation state to justify exactly one later additive high-turnover entry prototype?

fixed_market_state.evaluation_clock: first US30 real tick of each new M5 bar
fixed_market_state.synchronization: use only completed M5 bars whose close times align across all three symbols
fixed_market_state.impulse: For each symbol, log close[1] divided by close[4], representing the latest completed 15 minutes.
fixed_market_state.causal_scale: Sample standard deviation of 48 completed one-bar M5 log returns ending before the 15-minute impulse begins.
fixed_market_state.normalized_impulse: 15-minute log return divided by causal scale times sqrt(3).
fixed_market_state.cross_sectional_center: median normalized impulse of the three symbols
fixed_market_state.residual: symbol normalized impulse minus the cross-sectional median
fixed_market_state.selected_symbol: the symbol with greatest absolute residual; ties resolve US30, then US100, then US500
fixed_market_state.trigger: absolute selected residual is at least 1.5
fixed_market_state.rearm: after a completed observation, absolute maximum residual must return to at most 0.75 before another trigger
fixed_market_state.concurrency: at most one unresolved observation across the three symbols
fixed_market_state.outcome_horizon: first synchronized usable quote at or after 30 minutes

direction_hypotheses.CONTINUATION: same as the selected residual sign

fixed_cost_proxy.observed_cost: entry at contemporaneous ask and exit at contemporaneous bid for BUY, reversed for SELL
fixed_cost_proxy.double_spread_stress: gross midpoint result minus twice the entry-plus-exit half-spread burden
fixed_cost_proxy.conversion: OrderCalcProfit under the synchronized symbol contract
fixed_cost_proxy.commission_or_swap: zero for this 30-minute trade-free proxy; a later trading EA must use actual Tester deals and costs

fixed_output_contract.opportunity_row: one resolved row containing decision time, symbol, residual state, synchronized quotes, observed-spread and double-spread outcomes for both directions
fixed_output_contract.day_row: one row per server date containing synchronized eligible M5 evaluations and resolved opportunity count

fixed_integrity_gate: The final source compiles on MetaEditor build 6140 at 0 errors and 0 warnings before outcome.
Every path uses FPMarkets Every tick based on real ticks with all three required symbols synchronized.
Source, configuration, exercised history, selected-symbol database, full symbols database and required-symbol contract/swap fingerprints are recorded before outcome.
Selected-symbol and full symbols-database hashes plus logged contract/swap fields remain unchanged before and after each accepted path.
Every triggered observation resolves once, event identifiers are unique, and the observer reports zero listed fault.
No order, deal, position, CXR2 state or Live dependency exists.

environment_recovery_rule.first_fingerprint_change: discard the entire two-path output without economic judgment, freeze the synchronized fingerprint, and permit exactly one identical clean two-path rerun
environment_recovery_rule.second_fingerprint_change: invalidate and close Unit 022 without another rerun

fixed_selection_gate.normal_day: a server date with at least 120 synchronized eligible M5 evaluations
frequency: At least 3.0 resolved opportunities per normal day in LONG_OBSERVATION.
At least 3.0 resolved opportunities per normal day in ISOLATED_LATEST_OBSERVATION.
At least 250 resolved LONG observations and at least 30 isolated-latest observations.
economics: Positive pooled double-spread net USD and double-spread profit factor at least 1.10 over LONG_OBSERVATION.
Positive double-spread net USD in at least three of four selection subperiods including P4.
Positive pooled double-spread net USD for each of US30, US100 and US500, with at least 40 observations per symbol.
Observed-spread net USD must also be positive in every selection subperiod.
fixed_selection_gate.selection: Select at most one passing direction by greater pooled double-spread net USD, then greater minimum subperiod double-spread net USD, then REVERSION before CONTINUATION.
fixed_selection_gate.latest_use: Latest economics cannot select or rescue a direction; only frequency and observed spread scale are binding there.
fixed_selection_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one Unit 023 standalone high-turnover trading-prototype question with this unchanged signal, direction and 30-minute horizon. A later portfolio-combination unit must compare against and retain all six CXR2 strategies rather than treating the new strategy as the whole project.
fixed_selection_gate.failure_action: Close with no threshold, reset, horizon, session, weekday, symbol, direction-subgroup or volatility-estimator rescue.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before creating MQL source or opening any outcome.
Run only the fixed trade-free observer and the two fixed paths, except for the one environment clean-rerun allowance.
Do not place a Lab or Live order in Unit 022.
Do not read or modify current Live EA, Include, EX5, SET, state, log, dashboard or runtime.
Do not reopen Units 020-021 or use their invalid Unit 021 output.
Do not promote from exploratory evidence.
